name: encryptdecrypt-tools
description: Comprehensive client-side suite for 1,380+ zero-knowledge cryptographic operations, AES-256-GCM encryption, RSA, SHA-256/512 hashing, JWT debugging, Base64/Hex/URL encoding, UUID v4/v7, and developer utilities running 100% in browser RAM.

tools.name: aes_encrypt_decrypt
tools.description: Hardware-accelerated AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption and decryption compliant with NIST SP 800-38D.

tools.name: sha256_hash
tools.description: Compute collision-resistant SHA-256 cryptographic digest via W3C Web Cryptography API.

tools.name: base64_encode_decode
tools.description: RFC 4648 compliant Base64 encoding and decoding for binary and text strings.

tools.name: jwt_inspect_verify
tools.description: Decode and validate RFC 7519 JSON Web Token (JWT) header, claims payload, and HMAC signature.

tools.name: image_webp_converter
tools.description: In-browser high-efficiency image converter to WebP, PNG, and JPEG with lossy/lossless compression.
